usage: A common everyday noun for a self-service or regular laundrette; use it when talking about washing clothes outside home.
Often appears after verbs like 去, 搵, or 喺...附近, for example when saying you are going to a laundrette or looking for one nearby.
This word is neutral and very natural in daily Hong Kong speech; it is used for both small neighborhood laundrettes and larger laundry shops.
Good beginner word for errands and neighbourhood services; it is usually a location word, not something you ‘do’ to clothes directly.
